segments.line: Hey, can I borrow two hundred? Just till Friday.
That's the third time this month. Rent? Short. Savings? Gone. And Friday? Never comes.
Here's how to say no and keep the friend.
Don't answer right away. Buy yourself time.
Let me check and get back to you.
Then say no to the request, not the person.
I can't lend money right now...
And offer something you can give.
...but I can help you make a budget this weekend?
Come on, you always help me!
This is where most people cave. Don't.
I know. And I still can't. (beat, cricket)
Look what she did... A kind no beats a broke yes. Every time.
